truths.CP2:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', ''))
   OR p.category_raw NOT IN (SELECT c.category_name FROM categories AS c)
truths.CP4:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE p.sku <> UPPER(REPLACE(p.sku, ' ', ''))
   OR p.category_raw NOT IN (SELECT c.category_name FROM categories AS c)
